remarks: Enjoy this beautifully updated and sun-filled 1-bedroom, 1-bath top-floor corner unit - one of the largest in the desirable Woodside Green community. The home features hardwood floors throughout, a generous living room, and a spacious bedroom. The kitchen offers a breakfast bar and abundant granite counter space, perfect for cooking and entertaining. Woodside Green is known for its beautifully landscaped grounds, charming gazebo, and ample resident parking. Its unbeatable location puts you just steps from shops, restaurants, a coffee shop, supermarket, and the popular Scalzi Park. The community is pet-friendly and offers convenient laundry facilities in the lower level of the building. Ideal for commuters, this home is less than an hour from New York City via I-95, the Merritt Parkway, or Metro-North. Low HOA's $437.59 which includes hot water, cold water, cooking gas and a monthly Sewer charge of $22.08 Parking is numbered but not assigned you will receive a Parking Tag you can get a Visitors Pass as well.
